title: desmodium radicans
intro: Desmodium radicans, commonly known as Hempvine or Jumping Jack, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. The health benefits of Desmodium radicans include its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce fever, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium radicans include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
